integrity: A finite exact 49-support transition proof and integer coefficient arithmetic are provided with standalone source code, a complete transition table, and reproduced output. Finite state tests corroborate but do not replace the all-size proof. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Threshold-one synchronous three-state dynamics on labelled complete split graphs; the priority assertion is restricted to clique sizes at least three. The two-clique book-graph first-entry census and three-way conditional law are already known and explicitly not claimed. Earlier work establishes the qualitative dynamical dichotomy. Historical enumerations may exist.
title: Four-phase entrance statistics for three-state excitation on complete split graphs
